package.name: big_bertha_controllers
package.description: ros2_control controllers for Big Bertha. Provides JointEffortPdController, a synchronous joint-space effort-PD controller that emulates the Isaac Lab implicit actuator the gait policy was trained against: it reads position/velocity state with zero latency inside the controller_manager update and applies tau = Kp*(q_des - q) + Kd*(0 - qd), torque-limited.
